content.text:
A number of humanoid robots are currently listed for sale in Europe, mostly through specialist robotics suppliers. Prices below are the listed euro prices; many models are **on demand**, rather than in stock.[1][4]

- **Unitree R1** — listed from about **€10,164**; R1 EDU variants are listed from about **€15,972**.[1]
- **Booster Robotics K1** — GEEK, educational and professional versions are listed at roughly **€11,731–€19,799**.[1][10]
- **Unitree G1** — standard and EDU versions are listed from about **€19,789**, with higher-spec EDU configurations costing considerably more.[1]
- **DOBOT Atom** — D EDU, Max Research and Max EDU models are listed at about **€55,184–€94,255**.[1]
- **LimX Dynamics Oli EDU** — listed at about **€79,200**.[1]
- **AiMOGA Mornine** — listed at about **€93,170**.[1]
- **AgiBot A2 Ultra** and **G2 Wheeled** — listed at about **€122,143** and **€151,801**, respectively.[1]
- **UBTECH Walker S2** — listed at about **€242,000**.[1]

These are examples, not an exhaustive market list; availability and prices can change, and “listed” does not necessarily mean immediately deliverable. Check the seller for shipping to your country, VAT, lead time, and whether the model is intended for research or education rather than ordinary consumer use.[1]
